attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA will pursue full membership in the National Network on Cuba, as required by DSA’s 2019 Convention Resolution 62.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As a member of the National Network on Cuba, DSA hopes to organize in coalition with other National Network on Cuba member organizations to make ending the embargo of Cuba an issue of national priority.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA received a democratic mandate from its membership to play a role within the Cuban solidarity movement as part of its broader mission to support the growth of democratic socialism in the U.S. and abroad.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
